messages:
emily: Repro: sampleapp streaming hangs when routed through enterprise proxy. Final SSE event never dispatched. Happens consistently with their proxy appliance.

noah: Which SDK/version? Can you grab the raw TCP/stream capture?

emily: node sdk v0.9.4. Proxy log shows last chunk truncated — trailing blank line removed. Raw snippet: ```data: {"choices": [{"delta": "..."}] }\n``` then connection close. Parser waits for "\n\n" and never emits.

rashmi: We should treat socket close as implicit flush of buffered SSE frames. Also add an idle-flush that emits partial events after configurable ms of inactivity. That would cover flaky proxies and mobile networks.

noah: Agree. Additionally, some proxies re-segment or duplicate bytes; parser must assemble lines and dedupe obvious duplicates. Propose small dedupe window (5s) using event-id if present, else hash of payload.

emily: Can we add a small troubleshooting note to sampleapp README? New users keep filing tickets thinking the model hung. A one-liner about proxies removing trailing newlines would help.

rashmi: Plan: 1) change parser to line-oriented accumulation (don't assume chunk==event); 2) flush on EOF; 3) idle-flush default 600ms (configurable); 4) light dedupe by id/hash with 5s expiry; 5) add unit + integ tests simulating truncated/triplicate chunks.

ci-bot: CI: patch branch fix/sse-eof-idleflush created. Tests queued. :gear:

noah: For browsers, ensure fetch ReadableStream close triggers same flush behavior. Add e2e with headless chrome + throttling.

emily: I've attached a minimal curl repro and the proxy trace to the PR. Will draft README blurb.

ci-bot: Merged to main after green tests. Release note: "SDKs: improved SSE robustness — flush buffered events on connection close, configurable idle-flush timeout, and lightweight dedupe to handle proxy re-segmentation/duplication. See sampleapp README for proxy troubleshooting."
